reasoning: Research by Katz, Bommarito, et al. (2023) demonstrated that OpenAI's GPT-4 passed the Uniform Bar Examination (UBE) with a score of 297, placing it in approximately the 90th percentile of human test-takers. This significantly exceeds both the minimum passing threshold in all U.S. jurisdictions (which ranges from 260 to 270) and the average human test-taker score. Subsequent frontier language models (such as Claude 3 and GPT-4o) have replicated or exceeded these results.
